posts.text:
The @WHFraudTF had a great week!

- @FBIDirectorKash arrested one of America's Most Wanted fraudsters for $547M in fraud

- @SecScottBessent successfully implemented a verification process to stop payments from going to dead people

- @SecretaryTurner suspended funding to the Virgin Islands amid a massive fraud investigation

- @SecKennedy, @DrOzCMS deferred $1B in Medicaid payments to CA and MN

Fraudsters be warned: if you steal from the American people, we will hunt you down.

In the Trump Administration, we believe every American child should have a stake in their country's future. One way we’re making that happen is through Trump Accounts, which give $1,000 to every American child born between January 1, 2025 and December 31, 2028.

Trump Accounts make it easy for parents to set their children up for success — with a simple app and a policy designed to benefit hardworking American families. 

Thank you, President Trump and our great Treasury Secretary @SecScottBesse
